preconditions.description: The number of elements in the set S is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= 2 * 10**5 for s_i in S)
preconditions.description: Each element in the set S is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The length of the set S is exactly n.
All elements in the set S are distinct.

postconditions.description: The value of x is the largest non-negative integer such that there is a magical permutation of integers from 0 to 2^x - 1.
The length of the magical permutation is 2^x.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i < 2**x for p_i in permutation)
postconditions.description: Each element in the magical permutation is between 0 and 2^x - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i in set(permutation) for p_i in range(2**x))
postconditions.description: The magical permutation contains all integers from 0 to 2^x - 1 exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all((permutation[i] ^ permutation[i + 1]) in S for i in range(2**x - 1))
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of any two consecutive elements in the magical permutation is an element in the set S.
